Intelligence Sync is archived. Report CLI, conversion, engine or adapter problems in [ainova-systems/intelligence](https://github.com/ainova-systems/intelligence/issues).

When reporting a legacy conversion problem, include the legacy `sync_version`, operating system, `intelligence init --preview` output and the relevant portion of the old `config.yaml`.
